findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: Both fields have autocomplete='name', both are type='text', and both are labeled as a person's name. The form does not indicate why two separate name fields are needed.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate name field, or clarify why two separate name entries are needed.
findings.violation: The form asks for 'Full name' (#name-input, line 12) and then again asks for 'Your name' (#legalname-input, line 63), appearing to request the same information twice.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: The button appears at line 73, before the final fieldset and before the primary submit button. The form's fields flow from line 10-72, then the secondary button at 73, then more fields at 74-188, then the primary submit at 189.
findings.fix: Move the secondary action button to the bottom of the form, immediately before or after the primary submit button, and style it as visibly lesser.
findings.violation: The secondary action 'View details' is placed above the date-of-birth section (line 74-188), interrupting the column of fields before the primary submit button.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.

findings.evidence: The label at line 70 carries style='display:inline-block;float:left;width:140px', placing it beside the field. All other labels in the form use the default block layout, positioning them above their fields.
findings.fix: Remove the inline styles from the label to position it above the field, or apply the same left-aligned positioning to all labels consistently.
findings.violation: The label for 'Preferred contact time' is positioned to the left of its field using float:left and width:140px, while every other label in the form sits above its field.
